name: Algebraic Vector Embedding
description: Map the discrete domain {1,2,3} to orthogonal-like vectors in 3D space, replacing the explicit pairwise inequality constraint with a geometric dot product condition. This prevents the model from pattern-matching the problem to graph 3-coloring during the initial algorithmic planning phase, causing it to fall back to generic CSP backtracking which will TLE on dense or worst-case graphs of size 40 without degree-ordering heuristics.
